project.description: Continuous Integration Build Job for Containerized E-Notary Appointment System (Aryan Racha, Roll No: 23102C0055)

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
echo "==========================================================" echo " E-Notary Appointment System - Continuous Integration" echo " Student: Aryan Racha | Roll No: 23102C0055" echo " Trigger: SCM Scheduled Polling (H/15 * * * *)" echo " Execution Time: $(date)" echo "=========================================================="
WORKSPACE_DIR="$WORKSPACE" cd "$WORKSPACE_DIR"
echo "[1/4] Cloning / Updating repository source..." if [ ! -d "e-notary-repo" ]; then git clone /home/aryanracha/Coding/college/devops-project e-notary-repo else cd e-notary-repo git pull origin develop || git pull /home/aryanracha/Coding/college/devops-project develop cd .. fi
cd e-notary-repo git checkout develop git log -1 --oneline
echo "[2/4] Compiling Java classes and building React SPA..." ./mvnw clean compile
echo "[3/4] Executing automated regression and unit test suite..." ./mvnw test
echo "[4/4] Packaging executable JAR artifact..." ./mvnw package -DskipTests
# Stage artifact for archival mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE_DIR/dist" cp target/e-notary-appointment-system-*.jar "$WORKSPACE_DIR/dist/" echo "Artifact successfully generated: $(ls -lh "$WORKSPACE_DIR/dist/")"
